description: Type a line of text into the remote computer in one call. Use when you want to send text to another computer, for example a request typed into a window that is already focused there. Give `device` (a name or device_id from jrd_list_devices) to open a session first when none is open; omit it to use the open session. The text goes to whatever has keyboard focus on the remote computer and looks the same as the owner typing, so say who you are in the text. Set press_enter to send the Enter key afterwards. To talk to an agent on that computer without typing into its screen, use jrd_message_send instead. Fails when a session to a different computer is already open.

device.description: Name, device code or device_id of the computer to type on. Optional when a session is already open.

press_enter.description: Press Enter after the text. Default false.

text.description: The text to type on the remote computer.

name: jrd_send_text
